summary: The discussion proposes extending Spark Data Source V2 push-down to include additional relational operators such as full outer, semi, and anti joins, alias tolerance, join‑aggregate composition, set operations (UNION, INTERSECT, EXCEPT), and window functions. It introduces opt‑in interfaces that allow sources to decline support and considers enabling join push‑down by default. The team is actively monitoring the bot, implementing safety mechanisms to halt and revert if issues arise, and refining the trigger via the ai-review-requested label. Participants weigh the benefits of requiring Java 25, noting limited maintenance gains and unclear performance improvements, and ultimately agree to adopt Dongjoon's proposal.
